name: Atlanta–farm herd
summary: A herd leaves Atlanta after a helicopter draws its attention. Later, a gunshot draws it onto the Greene farm.

sources.title: Beside the Dying Fire · Walking Dead Wiki

phases.label: Leaves Atlanta
phases.description: The opening flashback shows walkers following a helicopter out of Atlanta.

phases.label: The farm is overrun
phases.description: Carl's gunshot attracts the passing herd to the farm. Its later destination is not established here.

name: Quarry–Alexandria herd
summary: Walkers escape a quarry. A horn diverts part of the herd toward Alexandria while another part continues away with the vehicle convoy.

sources.title: Herd · Walking Dead Wiki (TV Series section)

phases.label: Quarry release and split
phases.description: A failing barrier releases the herd. The horn diverts one branch toward Alexandria; the quarry and convoy route have no researched Atlas coordinates.

phases.label: Alexandria surrounded
phases.description: The diverted branch reaches the community's wall. This sequence follows that branch only.

phases.label: The wall is breached
phases.description: The damaged watchtower collapses and the herd enters the streets.

phases.label: Alexandria cleared
phases.description: The residents fight back and burning fuel helps eliminate the invading walkers.

name: Whisperer horde
summary: The Whisperers steer a horde into Alexandria and toward the survivors' hospital refuge. The survivors use sound and human guidance to divert it.

sources.title: A Certain Doom · Walking Dead Wiki

phases.label: Alexandria is empty
phases.description: Beta brings the horde into Alexandria. Finding it empty, the Whisperers continue searching for the survivors.

phases.label: The Tower is surrounded
phases.description: The horde descends on the hospital. A wagon carrying loudspeakers draws it away.

phases.label: Led over the cliff
phases.description: Lydia and Carol guide the walkers over a cliff. The cliff's precise location is not researched in the Atlas; the horde is finished.
